scope: Current factual acquisition, storage, and account-state boundaries for five durable utility items. This catalog records alternatives and fixed purchase requirements only; it does not rank a path, produce currency, infer a shop transaction, or select a route stop.

records.name: Herb sack acquisition alternatives and storage

ownership_and_storage.stores: Up to 30 each of the 15 normal grimy herb types, for 450 total. Noted or cleaned herbs cannot be stored.
ownership_and_storage.automatic_pickup_boundary: Only an open sack automatically accepts eligible picked-up or herb-patch/Herbiboar grimy herbs when there is space.

records.upgrade_boundary: A silklined upgrade exists, but its pristine-spider-silk acquisition and resulting capacity are outside this utility-item timing pass.

ownership_and_storage.stores: An unlimited quantity of up to six seed types.
ownership_and_storage.automatic_pickup_boundary: Whether a selected seed type is stored, its quantity, box open state, and later retrieval are player-observed.

records.name: Gem bag acquisition and storage

ownership_and_storage.stores: Up to 60 each of uncut sapphire, emerald, ruby, diamond, and dragonstone, for 300 total.
ownership_and_storage.automatic_pickup_boundary: Only an open bag automatically accepts eligible picked-up gems when there is space.

exclusions: Uncut opal, jade, and red topaz are not included in the base bag storage record.
Any later upgrade path is intentionally outside this pass and is not modeled here.

ownership_and_storage.stores: 27 coal, or 36 while a Smithing cape is equipped. It does not degrade.
ownership_and_storage.consumption_order: When smelting or superheating, stored coal is used after inventory coal.

records.name: Rune pouch acquisition alternatives and storage

acquisition_alternatives.shop_access_gate: 48 observed hours of member playtime and an observed available Justine shop row

ownership_and_storage.stores: 16,000 each of three rune types, excluding Nightmare Zone runes.
ownership_and_storage.spellcasting: Stored runes can be consumed for spellcasting.

records.non_ironman_path: A rune pouch note can be acquired through player trading/Grand Exchange and exchanged at a bank, but it is not an Ironman acquisition path.

account_state_contract.ownership: Use items.herb_sack, items.seed_box, items.gem_bag, items.coal_bag, and items.rune_pouch only after an explicit confirmed purchase/import observation.
account_state_contract.minigame_snapshots: When available, retain the matching minigame_activity_observations currency balance and confirmed purchase snapshot. The evaluator does not copy an observation balance into resources or infer a purchase from it.
account_state_contract.lms_shop_readiness: Last Man Standing's 48-hour member-playtime and current shop-row access must remain explicit observations. They are not currently converted into an executable purchase predicate.
prohibited_inferences: currency from a minigame session, Slayer task, planned activity, or elapsed time
shop access, member playtime, purchase, item ownership, stored contents, open/closed state, or equipped-state bonus
RNG, collection-log state, or strategic priority
